question: 'Dasbodh' is primarily a compilation of writings and sermons of ______.
solution:
Correct answer is __**Samarth Ramdas.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Samarth Ramdas** (c. 1608 - c. 1681), also popular as Sant (saint) Ramdas.
 
• Ramdas Swami was an Indian Hindu **saint, philosopher, poet, writer and spiritual master. **
 
• He was a devotee of the Hindu deities Rama and Hanuman<span style=&quo
